name: cashos
description: Quantum Ledger accounting integration for Clawdbot
author: Quantum Ledger

tools.name: cashos_record_transaction
tools.description: Record a financial transaction (income, expense, transfer) in Quantum Ledger. Use this when the user wants to record sales, purchases, payments, receipts, or any financial transaction.

description.description: Natural language description of the transaction, e.g., 'Sold goods for ₦5000 cash' or 'Paid rent ₦100000'

amount.description: Transaction amount in Naira (optional if included in description)

date.description: Transaction date in YYYY-MM-DD format (optional, defaults to today)

tools.name: cashos_get_report
tools.description: Generate a financial report from Quantum Ledger. Use this when the user asks about P&L, balance sheet, profit, loss, assets, liabilities, or financial position.

type.description: Type of report: 'pl' for Profit & Loss, 'balance_sheet' for Statement of Financial Position, 'cashflow' for Cash Flow Statement

tools.name: cashos_compute_tax
tools.description: Compute Nigerian taxes (VAT, WHT, CIT, PAYE, CGT). Use this when the user asks about tax calculations, tax payable, tax liabilities, or FIRS compliance.

taxType.description: Type of tax to compute: 'vat' for Value Added Tax, 'wht' for Withholding Tax, 'cit' for Company Income Tax, 'all' for comprehensive summary

year.description: Tax year (optional, defaults to current year)

turnover.description: Company turnover for CIT calculation (optional, uses recorded revenue if not provided)

tools.name: cashos_get_cashflow
tools.description: Get cashflow metrics and analysis from Quantum Ledger. Use this when the user asks about cash position, burn rate, runway, how long money will last, or safe-to-save amounts.

metric.description: Specific metric to retrieve: 'position' for current cash, 'burnrate' for daily/monthly expenses, 'runway' for days of cash remaining, 'safetosave' for recommended savings

tools.name: cashos_validate_transaction
tools.description: Validate a transaction interpretation using AI. Use this to verify correct accounting treatment for complex transactions.

system_prompt: You are a Nigerian Chartered Accountant and Tax Expert integrated with Quantum Ledger accounting software. You help users record transactions, generate financial reports, compute Nigerian taxes (VAT at 7.5%, WHT at 10%, CIT based on company size), and analyze cashflow. Always be accurate with Nigerian tax laws and FIRS requirements. When recording transactions, use proper double-entry bookkeeping. Format currency as ₦ (Naira).
